id: title:jurajmajerik:stop retrying metric config errors in timeseries

review.posthog_relevance: Changes exception handling and classification of metric calculation failures in PostHog's backend, distinguishing permanent errors from transient ones.
review.reason: The production implementation unifies exception handling by converting Pydantic and missing-import errors into DRF ValidationError, which downstream classification recognizes as permanent failures. This supports the permanent-error classification mechanism. Tests are provided but do not establish tier 3. No tier 3 systemic benefit is demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: The tier relies on the assumption that downstream classification correctly interprets DRF ValidationError as permanent; this is not independently verified in the supplied diff. No adoption or incident avoidance is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single-file change group. No cross-PR uncertainty exists. No tier assignment is performed here; this is an observation-only pass.

observations.behavior: Adds pydantic and DRF ValidationError imports, unifying exception handling.
observations.code_quote: from pydantic import ValidationError as PydanticValidationError
observations.posthog_connection: Allows distinguishing Pydantic construction failures from other exceptions in metric calculation, supporting the permanent-error classification.
Provides the classification function used later to distinguish transient from permanent errors.

observations.behavior: Defines _build_metric_validated to wrap metric construction and convert Pydantic errors to DRF ValidationError.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the failure path for malformed metric dicts from raising an exception to raising a DRF ValidationError, which is recognized as permanent by downstream classification.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only test code. No production implementation, configuration, or shared utility changes are supplied. No score can be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds several unit tests for the experiment metric calculation activity, including checks for permanent failure on validation errors and transient errors, and checks for saved-metric variants.
observations.posthog_connection: These assertions verify that the activity result status and database record status are set correctly when the underlying query runner fails, but this does not demonstrate or change the production behavior, only its testing.
